text: Wrapped-agent shell on a hosted instance, for admins only, through the one nginx-fronted port
description: Felix 2026-11-02: there will be nginx in front of the hosted instance, and only admin users should have the shell in wrapped agents. Today hosted mode refuses loop and watchdog entirely and runs no broker, so nobody has it. To give it to admins: run the broker on the hosted server, proxy broker and agent-session traffic (HTTP, tRPC WebSocket, Socket.IO) through the single hosted port (e.g. /broker/, /session/<port>/), and require an admin token on every hop: the backend's watchdog/loop routes need 'admin' instead of 'local', and the broker and each session server check the token (connectionParams / Socket.IO auth) against the project's accounts, because a session socket is a raw terminal. Origin checks stay; behind nginx the allowed origin is the public host (configure it, since BIND_HOST is 127.0.0.1 there). Non-admins never get a session port, a session id, or terminal output.

status.comment:
Opt-in per server: AIMPARENCY_AGENTS=true, asked in pnpm start --setup with the shell warning. It is off by default so that existing admins don't silently get a shell on update. With it on: run-local-stack starts the broker (node dist/index.js) with BIND_HOST=127.0.0.1, so its sessions are loopback too. backend/src/hosted-agent-gateway.ts on the one hosted port: POST /auth/agent-cookie turns an admin's bearer token into an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie (Secure behind X-Forwarded-Proto https) and refuses others; /broker and /session/<port>/ (port within PORT_PROCESS_START..+100 only) are proxied for HTTP and WebSocket upgrades only when the cookie's token resolves to an admin on every request and any Origin matches the Host; upstream sees a loopback Origin and no cookie. /trpc moved to noServer upgrade routing. access.ts: the watchdog router needs admin when agents are on (local otherwise). Frontend: runtime config 'agents'; broker at wss://<host>/broker and sessions at path /session/<port>/socket.io when hosted; the broker client holds operations until the cookie is set; the Watchdog button and w only for a logged-in admin with agents on; Loop stays local-only. README (hosting, roles, nginx X-Forwarded-Proto) and .env.example updated.

Evidence: hosted-agent-gateway.test.ts 4/4 against a real hosted server with a fake broker and session on loopback. Only an admin token gets the cookie, with the exact flags. Session HTTP is 403 without a cookie or with a writer's cookie, and nothing reaches upstream; with an admin cookie it reaches upstream as /socket.io/?EIO=4..., with a loopback origin and no cookie. Broker and session WebSockets echo for an admin; a missing cookie, a writer's cookie or a foreign Origin get 403, and an unknown path 404. Route tests: MCP port and out-of-range ports are refused; neededRole('watchdog.*') is admin with agents and local without. runtime-config tests cover hosted/local URLs; validate:local-runtime checks BROK appears only with agents; pnpm check 25/25.

Not covered: a live trial on the Commons Hub server behind nginx. Known limit: an agent started there reaches the Aimparency MCP only if its MCP config points at the hosted /trpc with a token; without one it can only read.
